# transmit_oncall_team (Resource)

A team of responders. Teams can own schedules and escalation policies; deleting a team is refused while it still owns one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "transmit_oncall_team" "sre" {
  configuration_id = transmit_oncall_configuration.prod.id
  name             = "SRE"
  responder_ids    = [transmit_oncall_responder.dana.id, transmit_oncall_responder.lee.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `configuration_id` (String) The on-call configuration this belongs to. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `responder_ids` (Set of String) Members of the team.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <configuration_id>/<team_id>
terraform import transmit_oncall_team.sre 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001/00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002
```
